title: CAREER RAIDS: THE VAULTS
why: His rule of 2026-10-12: the gameplay elements are exactly the same in DEMO and CAREER. A CAREER raid now has the DEMO vaults: two strongrooms sealed behind a keycard door with a vault gun inside, a Vault Keycard hidden in an ordinary box outside each, and keycards dropped by the fight (an elite or the boss while a vault is still shut, or every 12th kill when no keycard is left). Opening a vault pays VAULT OPEN +$500 into your CAREER score. The rest of the raid is built exactly as before.
now: CAREER raids have the DEMO vaults and keycards, and a vault pays +500 to your score.
